fit: injected isolated myrcene and pentobarbital sleep in mice
assessment: Mean time under pentobarbital was 40.9 minutes in controls and 64.0 and 106.6 after injected isolated myrcene. Motor performance also declined. The food preparation and spontaneous sleep remained untested.

fit: oral isolated myrcene and pentobarbital sleep in rats
assessment: A single dose prolonged barbiturate sleep and repeated dosing with a different challenge interval shortened it. Authors attribute the timing-dependent results to drug metabolism. No culinary ingestion or spontaneous insomnia was measured.

fit: injected beta-caryophyllene and acute mouse behavior
assessment: More open-arm time and less immobility in behavioral tests followed injection of isolated beta-caryophyllene. This does not establish a clinical outcome from the food preparation.

fit: oral isolated beta-caryophyllene and evoked mouse pain responses
